editorial: Imagine sliding through a world where a troupe of misfits pull a heist that turns into a living comic strip. Every companion, from a sly enchanter with a penchant for sarcasm to a brooding rogue with a haunted past, plays off each other in comic‑book timing while subtle nods to D&D lore anchor the immersion. Joaquin Phoenix, as the smooth‑talking thief, turns each stealth sequence into a punchline‑heavy showcase of dry wit. The film never quite breaks into its own pacing, though the third act rushes through the stakes and leaves a few plot threads feeling shy. Ideal for fans of high‑energy fantasy adventures that mix sharp dialogue with mythic set pieces and yearning for a playful, over‑the‑top hero journey.
